- Now we need 8 more lapis lazuli. Look around locations where new lapis lazuli blocks might spawn or check chests and other players' inventories. Gather these 8 pieces.
- Combine the existing lapis lazuli from step 2 and the 8 new pieces to craft 1 more lapis block.
- To finalize, place all 9 lapis lazuli pieces into a crafting grid to create the required lapis block.
